next_steps.action: Disconnect all power. Measure resistance from rail to ground.

measure.where: LDO output pin / rail test point
measure.expected: LDO rails typically >50 ohm to ground; <10 ohm suggests a shorted load or output cap.
measure.safety: Discharge all caps first; never measure resistance on a powered rail.

interpretations.then: Short on the LDO output. Hunt the shorted component before re-applying power.
No short. Proceed to check LDO input.
